description: This file defines an onboarding screen for a Flutter application. It presents a multi-page onboarding flow with icons, titles, and descriptions, and includes navigation controls to skip or proceed through the onboarding process. It also interacts with an external authentication service to mark onboarding as complete and navigates to a login screen.

classes.name: OnboardingScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the onboarding flow, responsible for rendering onboarding pages.

classes.name: _OnboardingPager
classes.description: A stateful widget managing the paging of onboarding content.

classes.name: _OnboardingPagerState
classes.description: The state class for _OnboardingPager, managing page index and navigation controls.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the onboarding screen widget tree, including pages and navigation controls.

methods.name: _buildPage
methods.description: Constructs individual onboarding pages with icon, title, and descriptive text.
